accepted_with_reason.reason: The redaction bar's hatch. DESIGN.md specifies this exact pattern as the redaction treatment; a solid block would read as a censored field rather than a printed one.
DESIGN.md's Decisions Log records the em-dash as the house parenthetical device. 13 in the dashboard's body copy is at the top of what reads naturally and is worth watching, not a defect.

Fixed rather than accepted: the four literals flagged were the prefers-contrast:more ramp (#4F4D49, #B4B6BB, #B6AF9F, #3C3F46). Legitimate values that were undocumented, so they were moved into DESIGN.md and tokens.css as named contrast tokens and the media query now references them.

departures: The skill specifies one page per invocation. The user explicitly asked for the whole product, so this run covers four surfaces that share one token set and one behaviour file. Recorded here rather than silently.

No source mockup and no AI-generated mockups: OPENAI_API_KEY is unset and the zero-budget constraint forbids buying one, so the run took the plan-driven path from docs/designs/veil-agent-payments.md. Source-zero is 'no mockup', which is why mode is plan-driven and source_mockup is null.
The outside voice (Codex) is not installed, so no adversarial second opinion was available in this phase. Missing coverage, not a blocker.
content_rule: Every figure on every surface is injected by scripts/build-pages.ts from data/demo/run.json and data/fixtures/responses.json, which are captured from a real run against a real ephemeral HTTP server. The build refuses to render if run.json is absent, so no surface can describe a run the software did not perform.
